dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Orioles Pound White Sox, Dodgers Fall to Athletics**

The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Chicago White Sox 6-1 behind Noah Schultz's 4.1 innings of work, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs. Sam Antonacci led the White Sox offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In the Texas Rangers' 9-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, Austin Hedges homered twice, driving in 3 runs. MacKenzie Gore took the loss, allowing 2 earned runs in 5 innings.

The Washington Nationals crushed the Boston Red Sox 10-2, with James Wood hitting a home run and driving in 3 runs. Andrew Alvarez earned the win with 4.2 scoreless innings. In the Detroit Tigers' 6-2 win over the New York Yankees, Kevin McGonigle hit a home run and Troy Melton pitched 6.1 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 7.
